<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 500 550" width="500" height="550">
  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="#ffffff" />

  <!-- Cliff (vertical line on the left with hatching) -->
  <line x1="120" y1="50" x2="120" y2="480" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />
  <!-- Cliff hatching -->
  <line x1="120" y1="70" x2="100" y2="90" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <line x1="120" y1="120" x2="100" y2="140" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <line x1="120" y1="170" x2="100" y2="190" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <line x1="120" y1="220" x2="100" y2="240" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <line x1="120" y1="270" x2="100" y2="290" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <line x1="120" y1="320" x2="100" y2="340" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <line x1="120" y1="370" x2="100" y2="390" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <line x1="120" y1="420" x2="100" y2="440" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <line x1="120" y1="470" x2="100" y2="490" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />

  <!-- Rope going up to top right -->
  <line x1="260" y1="170" x2="400" y2="50" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="340" y="100" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-style="italic" font-size="14">rope</text>

  <!-- Rock Climber Stick Figure / Simplified Body -->
  <!-- Center of mass / torso -->
  <circle cx="250" cy="240" r="16" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" /> <!-- Head -->
  <line x1="250" y1="256" x2="250" y2="340" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" /> <!-- Torso -->
  <!-- Arms (reaching up-right to rope) -->
  <line x1="250" y1="280" x2="260" y2="170" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />
  <!-- Legs (pressing against cliff at x=120, y=380) -->
  <line x1="250" y1="340" x2="120" y2="380" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />
  <!-- Feet in contact with cliff -->
  <circle cx="120" cy="380" r="4" fill="#000000" />

  <!-- Caption -->
  <text x="200" y="520" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">Fig. 2.1</text>
</svg>
